'''Patrol Squad 34/258''' was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] assigned to the [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] on [[Koovis]]. Comprised of twelve stormtroopers, the squad was armed with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and carried two [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blasters]].
